estimand: 252 times mean aligned daily net candidate-minus-momentum difference; session-weighted annual group means; no real inputs
materiality: Estimated annual paired mean >=0.02 AND positive two-sided95 lower endpoint AND one-sided primary p<=0.05
robustness: All three estimated stressed effects positive; no additional discoveries or p-value winners
stress_offsets_status: Illustrative synthetic mean penalties, not calibrated real transaction/delay effects
other_worlds: Stress diagnostics for the corresponding method; violations retained, never relabelled after results
student_assumptions: Common group mean, independent approximately Gaussian group means, group variance inversely proportional to session count; AR05 is a finite-horizon approximation check, not proof of independence
sign_assumptions: Common additive group location, independent symmetric errors; arbitrary group variance allowed; no random assignment claimed
observation_partition: Calendar year intersected with each independently funded confirmation window; never combine observations across funding boundaries inside a group; actual elapsed session counts include partial2026
null_gate: For every certification world and joint structure: primary type-I/FWER Wilson95 upper<=0.10; one confirmatory discovery means FWER equals primary rejection
coverage_gate: Two-sided95 mean/location confidence coverage Wilson95 lower>=0.90 in certification worlds; confidence must be bounded to advance
power_gate: Complete primary/materiality/stress support Wilson95 lower>=0.80 at +0.05 annual effect, 0.025 annual tracking error, all declared Student certification worlds and joint structures
mde: Smallest fixed-grid effect with complete-support Wilson95 lower>=0.80 across joint structures in iid sensitivity; no interpolation or claim beyond grid
failures: Retain p=1, uncovered/unbounded interval, no support; failures counted in denominator
selection: First method satisfying resolution, bounded interval, null/coverage and useful-power gates; selection is conditional synthetic only. Compare stages using scientific isolation/source/adapter tradeoffs, not raw sample count alone
real_assumptions: UNESTABLISHED; no real method certification or strategy stage opened
